entities.name: Suzuki coupling prediction
observations: Pd-catalyzed Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling is predicted between the substrate aryl bromide and the organoboron partner.
The aryl C–Br bond is replaced by a biaryl C–C bond; ester, ether, and other scaffold functionality remains unchanged.
The organoboron partner decodes as 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl boronic acid, OB(O)C1=CC=C2C(=C1)OCO2.
The exact product is predicted from reaction logic; the search returned close phenyl and thiophen-2-yl analogues rather than an exact product record.
